execution.progress: Inspect and trial complete in one round. Recover is paid work in increments of at most 0.1 m2 whose exact job, reserved portion, component ledger and products persist across interruption; resume pays only the next increment after revalidation; completion, stop, cancellation and death settle once.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Inspect: target a visible object or item in reach (your own carried items count), one round and 0.2 energy (the baseline probe observation; no second charge), no material used. Separation-trial: target your own carried fallen-branch stack, one round and 0.5 energy on exactly 0.1 unit split off from it. Recover: target your own carried fallen-branch stack and quantity (0.1 steps, default all); needs your own earlier trial on material from the same source. Work is one increment per round of at most 0.1 m2 of bark surface at 1 energy each, including a smaller final increment (one branch unit carries about 0.18 m2); recover pays the first and the same action continues each round; resume pays the next increment; cancel takes one round and no energy. Hand only: a toolId is refused at no cost. Travel and gathering are separate actions.
details.effects: Represented composition (stated assumptions): one untreated fallen-branch unit (1.1 mass) is 0.99 wood and 0.11 attached bark (the bark-extraction@1 share), bark covers about 0.18 m2 at the bark unit basis of 0.3 mass per 0.5 m2, on a 2 m piece of about 0.09 m circumference, and separates by hand from the broken ends. Other materials have no represented bark composition: inspection reports them as unresolved and trial and recovery are refused at no cost. Inspect records only visible facts as a personal unverified record: bark covering, exposed edges, piece length, circumference, covered, separated and torn areas; attached mass and separability stay unknown until your own trial. The trial lifts and tears the bark of the 0.1 portion (recorded waste, about 0.011 mass) and reports edge, separation behaviour and bark share; the portion keeps its wood as its own stack. Each recover increment detaches real attached bark: every whole 0.03-mass tenth becomes ordinary carried bark (resource bark, same origin and harvest date, no other record), usable wherever bark units are used; a remainder below a tenth is recorded waste. The worked portion stays branch whose mass per unit falls by exactly the bark removed (0.99 when bare) and carries a separation record, so the shelters, which take only untreated units, do not accept it. Wood, attached bark, recovered bark and waste always sum to the input. Only the selected portion is reserved; it stays carried. Work not continued in a round pauses; too little energy pauses without spending; lost or changed material stops the work. Cancel returns the remainder in its actual state; death drops it on the ground. Completed products, damage, time and energy are never refunded. No shelter, comfort, food, regrowth or reward follows from separation.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 4000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form.
